other_failure_modes.name: String conversion masking missing values
other_failure_modes.description: Calling `.astype(str)` on a pandas column before filling missing values converts `NaN` to the string literal `'nan'`, which renders the subsequent `.fillna()` operation completely ineffective.

summary: The agent provides a solid baseline using a CatBoostClassifier with 5-fold Stratified CV. However, it lacks any feature engineering and relies on a naive unweighted ensemble of the folds. Additionally, there is a pandas bug in the preprocessing where casting to string before filling missing values masks the NAs by converting them to the string 'nan'.
